name: cf7-live-preview
description: Preview a Contact Form 7 form and its email from the editor, with your theme's styles and without saving.
author: Marios Giannopoulos

scripts.compat:on: wp-env run cli wp plugin activate cf7-conditional-fields contact-form-7-multi-step-module ultimate-addons-for-contact-form-7
scripts.compat:off: wp-env run cli wp plugin deactivate cf7-conditional-fields contact-form-7-multi-step-module ultimate-addons-for-contact-form-7
scripts.i18n:make-pot: wp-env run cli -- wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/cf7-live-preview wp-content/plugins/cf7-live-preview/languages/cf7-live-preview.pot --slug=cf7-live-preview --domain=cf7-live-preview --exclude=node_modules,vendor,.git,languages,tests
scripts.bundle: mkdir -p build && bestzip build/cf7-live-preview.zip cf7-live-preview.php includes/ templates/ assets/js/ assets/css/ languages/ uninstall.php readme.txt changelog.txt LICENSE
